message.content:
This is a timing chain guide for a gasoline engine (Hyundai/Kia Theta engine). It is a part suitable for use solely or principally with spark-ignition internal combustion piston engines, which points to heading 8409. Subheading 8409.91 covers parts for spark-ignition engines, and 8409.91.50 is the "Other" tariff line for parts suitable for use with engines other than aircraft engines. Within 8409.91, the statistical lines are:
- 8409.91.10: for aircraft engines
- 8409.91.50: other, for use with engines of 8407 (but see the tariff structure)

The actual 8409.91 structure is:
- 8409.91.10 – Of aircraft engines (the aircraft-engine line)
- 8409.91.50 – Other: Cylinder blocks, crankcases (older)
- 8409.91.9990 – Other

Current HTS lines:
- 8409.91.1000 – Parts for aircraft engines
- 8409.91.2000 – Cylinder blocks and crankcases (for marine propulsion engines)
- 8409.91.5000 – Other: Fuel injection... 
- 8409.91.9990 – Other

I'm not fully certain of the sub-lines, but the common classification for engine parts such as timing chain guides is 8409.91.9990, so I'll use it.
